The present petition has been filed under Section 528 of BNSS for quashing of FIR no. 449/2023 under Section 279/338 IPC registered at PS Fatehpur Beri.

The FIR was lodged on the statement of the complainant wherein he has alleged that while he was driving the scooty bearing no. DL 3S BM 5360, the offending vehicle bearing no. DL- 9CW-5848 was being driven by the accused and hit respondent no. 2.
After investigation, the charge-sheet was filed under Section 279/338 IPC.

However, the parties have now entered into a MoU dated 18.10.2023 on the following terms and conditions:

sentences.text: That the first party has agreed to pay a sum of Rs. 1,10,000/- in two installments.
Upon receiving the first installment of Rs 60,000/- which shall be paid at the time of statement of parties before the Hon'ble Court of Ms. Manushree Ld. MM, Saket Court, New Delhi.

That the first party will provide the passport size photograph,
Aadhar Card and relevant documents for compounding/closing/quashing of the above-mentioned FIR.

The Second installment of Rs 50,000/- shall be handed over to the Second Party at the time of statement of parties in Quashing petition before the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi for the quashing of FIR Bearing NO.449/2019 U/S 279,338 of IPC, PS Fatehpur Beri.
It is also agreed between the parties that the First Party shall Co- operate for the Compounding/Quashing of the case against the Second Party.

3. That the parties undertake, that on the completion of the above process,
successfully, execution of the terms of the present settlement agreement and after the closure / compounding / quashing of the above-mentioned FIR they shall be left with no claims/disputes- Civil, Criminal against each other what so ever and their respective family members, relatives before any court of law, police authority or public authority.

4. That the contents of this agreement have been read over to the parties vernacular and they have been explained the terms of this agreement settlement and they have understood the same to be true and shall be governed by the same.
5. The parties to the MoU herein, undertake to abide and bound by the terms of the present Memorandum of Understanding.

The parties accept that in case they breach any of the terms of the present Memorandum of Understanding, then the present respective parties shall be entitled to take recourse available to them as per law."
2. Respondent No. 2 has stated that he has entered into the settlement voluntarily without any force,
fear and coercion.
Respondent no. 2 has This is a digitally signed order.

IO has identified both the parties.
Respondent no. 2 states that he has received the entire amount.
3. In view of the above, FIR no. 449/2023 under Section 279/338 IPC registered at PS Fatehpur Beri and all the other proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
4. The present petition along with all pending applications stand disposed of.
